sentences.text: Versus State of Jharkhand & Ors. .... .... Respondent(s)

------
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ananda Sen.
------

For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. A.K. Sahani, Advocate For the Respondent : Mrs. Darshana Poddar Mishra, AAG-I 5/15.02.2023 Principal Judicial Commissioner, Ranchi is directed to send the entire file of Complaint Case No. 1592 of 2017 registered under Section 498A & 494 IPC along with the copy of the order which settled the dispute in the Lok Adalat and different documents executed before the Lok Adalat, immediately before this Court on 17.02.2023 through Special Messenger.

Let a copy of this order be communicated through FAX to the Judicial Commissioner, Ranchi through Registrar General, Jharkhand High Court, who will ensure that the entire file of Complaint Case No.1592 of 2017 be sent to this Court before 10.30 a.m at 17.02.2023.
List this case on 17.02.2023 under the heading 'For Orders'.

(ANANDA SEN , J) anjali/cp2 Sarojani Toppo vs State Of Jharkhand & Ors on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72073073/
